Compression: block_boundary=2.9022 (0% FP) → JPEG exists; full-context severity scan 3→4→5 gave bb diffs 27%(alone)/8%→39%→105% in context → sev3 (q=12) is the only full-context match, and sev3 matches bb on support pairs 0/2/4. Blur family: PCA 3.871-5.505 >2.5 on 5/5 pairs (0% FP) -> motion. Pair1 residual_anisotropy=1.602 falls BELOW the 1.7 decision threshold - a threshold-boundary case - but PCA is the primary 0% FP signal, so motion stands. glass_score 0.703-1.215 (>0.25 on all pairs) is a previously under-examined signal; rejected because glass is shuffle-based and cannot produce radial spectral_slope -1.219..-1.702 or directional PCA; the deterministic lens:5 probe fails slope (diff 0.090) and wiener (0.392) on pair0.
Blur severity: gm_ratio -> est severities 5/5/5/5/4 (pair4 boundary). motion:4 in the correct jpeg:3 context is mixed (pair0 slope diff 0.090 fail; pair4 slope+bb match) -> keep motion:5.

Noise: the full_analysis 'GAUSSIAN_YCrCb high-confidence' verdict is driven by cross_channel_corr 0.83-0.97, a documented blur+JPEG false-positive path (failure_risk FP_YCrCb_BLUR_JPEG). Re-derived the expected residual channel-std ratio for noise_gaussian_YCrCb:1 through the inverse YCrCb transform: Var(R):Var(G):Var(B) = 2.97:1.63:4.14 -> ratio ~2.54. Measured residual rgb_ratio=1.065 -> YCrCb ruled out; gaussian_RGB retained.

Noise presence and order: noise:sigma (wavelet HH MAD of target vs simulated image) matches within 20% with noise_gaussian_RGB:1 on 5/5 fresh control draws (and 5/5 in R0). The noise-last probe (blur_motion:5,compression_jpeg:3,noise_gaussian_RGB:1) gives sigma diff 6054% and bb diff 54% -> noise must precede blur and JPEG (attenuated by blur), consistent with the generator priority and R0. No direct signal supports deleting the noise step; the target's residual noise_prior_sigma 0.74-3.71 is content/JPEG dependent and near the sigma=2 gate only on pair0.

Global: 4/5 pairs NO_GLOBAL. Pair1 alone fires SATURATION_strengthen_sev3 (chroma_ratio 1.160) while other pairs show 0.865-0.956 (JPEG chroma-subsampling direction is weakening); a shared pipeline cannot be present in only 1/5 pairs and the saturation signal is a documented mixed-degradation FP (~33%) -> rejected. Contrast/brightness ruled out by variance_ratio 0.684-0.934 (contrast_weaken_scale:1 would give ~0.56) and mean_shift -0.3..-1.3/255.

Verification check-set asymmetry (key methodological finding): verify_signals computes noise:sigma and noise:structured_residual(FWHM) only when the pipeline contains noise_*. The control therefore has 5 checks and the no-noise ablation only 3. FWHM is the structural-residual check that the random motion-blur angle (x_distortion blur_motion draws np.random.uniform(-90,90) per call) almost always violates; omitting it automatically upgrades WEAK to PARTIAL/MATCH.

decision.rationale: No candidate passes a valid improvement test. The deterministic core beats every alternative (jpeg:4 bb diff 29-39%; motion:4 mixed with a slope failure; lens:5 slope diff 0.090 + wiener 0.392), and no global step is supported (pair1 saturation is a 1/5 content artifact). The noise step remains UNCERTAIN in type but is not contradicted: gaussian_RGB:1 reproduces the sigma signal on 10/10 paired observations, YCrCb is ruled out by rgb_ratio (expected ~2.54 vs measured 1.065), and post-blur noise is ruled out by the 6054% sigma mismatch. The no-noise ablation's PARTIAL/MATCH sweep is a check-set artifact (FWHM check omitted) rather than a real gain, so R0's pipeline is retained unchanged.
decision.limitations: Per-call random motion angle in x_distortion blur_motion makes residual-structure checks (Wiener kernel, FWHM) draw-dependent; single-draw comparisons therefore cannot fully separate candidates. Only integer severities exist. Without GT we cannot arbitrate C0 vs C1 by PSNR; the R1 decision relies on signal symmetry and the controlled same-pair normalization.
